sentence_stem: I wish I had known about the meeting earlier,
correct_completion: so I would have arrived on time.
full_sentence: I wish I had known about the meeting earlier, so I would have arrived on time.
acceptable_variants: so I could have arrived on time.
so I would have been on time.

options.text: so I can arrive on time tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Can arrive tomorrow' refers to the future, but the stem expresses a regret about the past.

options.text: so I would have arrived on time.
so I arrive on time every day.
options.why_wrong: This is a habit in the present, which does not match the regret expressed by 'I wish I had known'.

options.text: so I will be late again.
options.why_wrong: This is a prediction about the future, not an unreal past result.

grammar_focus: Third conditional after 'I wish' to express past regret
explanation: After 'I wish' with the past perfect, the result clause uses would have plus a past participle to express an unreal past outcome.
translation: Eu queria ter sabido da reunião mais cedo, então teria chegado no horário.
